age 1) ---

The following text is from Northrop Frye's 1957 book Anatomy of Criticism.

Even in lyrics and essays the writer is to some extent a fictional hero with a fictional audience, for if the element of fictional projection disappeared completely, the writing would become direct address, or straight discursive writing, and cease to be literature.

As used in the text, what does the word "projection" most nearly mean?

A) Estimation
B) Presentation
C) Elimination
D) Prediction

While some people believe they can reduce monthly air-conditioning costs simply by closing air registers in vacant rooms, this practice can actually reduce the ____ climate-control systems by creating internal pressure imbalances that restrict airflow across critical components and force motors to work harder.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

A) limitation on
B) efficiency of
C) expense of
D) need for

Research has shown that regardless of musical training, most hearing adults recognize that the notes of the simple melody of "Baa Baa Black Sheep" are harmonious. Similarly, a study showed that even participants with no musical training could easily follow the underlying beat in the Brazilian samba song "Mas Que Nada" despite its often complex rhythms, raising the possibility that this capability was somehow ____ the participants.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

A) instinctive for
B) unique to
C) imposed on
D) undertaken by
